title: Extract multiple strings from a column in a new column as a list in pyspark dataframe
question:
Have a pyspark dataframe with a single column with below values (Only 2 records for example)-

+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|data                                                                                                  |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
{Job : "Job A", Condition: "Pass"},{Job : "Job B", Condition: "Pass"}
{Job : "Job C", Condition: "Pass"},{Job : "Job D", Condition: "Pass"},{Job : "Job E", Condition: "Pass"}
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

I am looking to extract the job names only in a list in a separate column.

Desired Outcome-

+-----------------------+
|data1                                                                                                  |
+-----------------------+
["Job A","Job B"]
["Job C","Job D","Job E"]
+-----------------------+

Any easy way i can do it in pyspark?
answer:
The json strings are malformed, so we need to add quotes and brackets.

df = df.withColumn('data_cleaned', F.concat(F.lit('['),F.regexp_replace('data', '\{Job', '\{"Job"'), F.lit(']')))
df = df.withColumn('data_cleaned_final', F.regexp_replace('data_cleaned', 'Condition', '"Condition"'))
w = Window.orderBy(df.data)
df = df.withColumn("id", F.row_number().over(w))

schema = ArrayType(StructType([
    StructField("Job", StringType()),
    StructField("Condition", StringType())
]))

df_final = df.withColumn(
    "data_json", F.from_json(F.col("data_cleaned_final"), schema)
).withColumn(
    "job", F.explode(F.col('data_json.Job'))
).groupby('id').agg(F.array_agg('job').cast(StringType()).alias('data1'))

Final result:

+---+---------------------+
|id |data1                |
+---+---------------------+
|1  |[Job A, Job B]       |
|2  |[Job C, Job D, Job E]|
+---+---------------------+
